questionText: Complete the sentence: "Smoking _____ health."
explanation: "Tell upon" idiom-টির অর্থ ক্ষতি করা বা স্বাস্থ্যের ওপর ক্ষতিকর প্রভাব ফেলা। তাই "Smoking tells upon health" এর অর্থ ধূমপান স্বাস্থ্যের ক্ষতি করে।

questionText: Complete the sentence: "The girl _____ her mother."
explanation: "Take after" phrasal verb-টির অর্থ দেখতে একই রকম হওয়া বা সদৃশ হওয়া। তাই সঠিক বাক্যটি হলো "The girl takes after her mother" (মেয়েটি দেখতে তার মায়ের মতো)।

questionText: Complete the sentence: "He _____ his shoes."
explanation: "Take off" means to remove clothing or footwear (জুতো বা পোশাক খোলা)। তাই বাক্যটির অর্থ সে তার জুতো খোলে।

questionText: Complete the sentence: "The incident _____ before my eyes."
explanation: "Take place" idiom-টির অর্থ কোনো ঘটনা ঘটা বা সংঘটিত হওয়া। বাক্যটির অর্থ হলো ঘটনাটি আমার চোখের সামনে ঘটেছিল।

questionText: What is the meaning of "Tall talk"?
explanation: "Tall talk" ইডিয়ামটির অর্থ হলো বাড়িয়ে কথা বলা বা বড় কথা বলা (boasting or exaggeration)।

questionText: Complete the sentence: "We should _____ in any kind of danger."
explanation: "Take heart" idiom-টির অর্থ সাহস সঞ্চয় করা বা আশাবাদী হওয়া। তাই বিপদে আমাদের সাহস ধরে রাখা উচিত।

questionText: What is the meaning of "Turn down"?
explanation: "Turn down" phrasal verb-টির অর্থ হলো কোনো প্রস্তাব বা আবেদন নাচক বা প্রত্যাখ্যান করা (to reject or refuse)।

questionText: Complete the sentence: "He followed my advice _____."
explanation: "To the letter" idiom-টির অর্থ অক্ষরে অক্ষরে বা হুবহু পালন করা। অর্থাৎ সে আমার পরামর্শ অক্ষরে অক্ষরে মেনে চলেছিল।

questionText: Which idiom best completes the sentence: "He fought _____ against his poverty."
explanation: "Tooth and nail" idiom-টির অর্থ সর্বশক্তি দিয়ে বা প্রাণপণে লড়াই করা। বাক্যটির অর্থ সে দারিদ্র্যের বিরুদ্ধে প্রাণপণে লড়াই করেছিল।

questionText: Complete the sentence: "He was taken _____ for negligence of duty."
explanation: "Take to task" একটি ইডিয়াম যার অর্থ তিরস্কার করা বা কৈফিয়ত চাওয়া। অবহেলার জন্য তাকে তিরস্কার করা হয়েছিল।

questionText: Complete the sentence: "Don't roam about _____."
explanation: "To and fro" idiom-টির অর্থ এদিক-ওদিক বা যত্রতত্র ঘুরাঘুরি করা। বাক্যটি নির্দেশ করছে এদিক-ওদিক ঘুরে বেড়িও না।

questionText: Complete the sentence: "He took his remark _____."
explanation: "Take to heart" idiom-টির অর্থ কোনো কথা বা বিষয় মনে নেওয়া বা গভীরভাবে কষ্ট পাওয়া।

questionText: Complete the sentence: "We _____ a doctor."
explanation: "Send for" phrasal verb-টির অর্থ ডেকে পাঠানো। "We send for a doctor" অর্থ আমরা একজন ডাক্তার ডেকে পাঠাই।

questionText: Complete the sentence: "He advanced _____."
explanation: "Step by step" অর্থ ধাপে ধাপে বা ধীরে ধীরে। বাক্যটির অর্থ সে ধাপে ধাপে এগিয়েছিল।

questionText: What is the meaning of "So and so"?
explanation: "So and so" ইডিয়ামটি দিয়ে নির্দিষ্ট কিছু না বুঝিয়ে সাধারণ বা এক রকম অবস্থাকে বোঝায়।

questionText: Complete the proverb: "_____ wins the race."
explanation: এটি একটি বিখ্যাত প্রবাদ বাক্যাংশ: "Slow and steady wins the race" (ধীর ও ধারাবাহিক প্রচেষ্টাই জয় এনে দেয়)।

questionText: Complete the sentence: "The prisoners were _____."
explanation: "Set free" idiom-টির অর্থ মুক্ত করা বা মুক্তি দেওয়া। তাই বন্দীদের মুক্তি দেওয়া হয়েছিল।

questionText: Complete the sentence: "I _____ food the whole house."
explanation: "Search for" অর্থ খোঁজা বা অনুসন্ধান করা। পুরো ঘরে খাবারের সন্ধান বা খোঁজা বোঝাতে "searched for" ব্যবহৃত হয়েছে।

questionText: What is the meaning of "Rise in arms"?
explanation: "Rise in arms" idiom-টির অর্থ অস্ত্র হাতে তুলে নেওয়া বা সশস্ত্র বিদ্রোহ ঘোষণা করা।

questionText: Complete the sentence: "There is _____ in every man's life."
explanation: "Rise and fall" idiom-টির অর্থ জীবনের উত্থান-পতন বা ভালো-মন্দ সময়। মানুষের জীবনে উত্থান-পতন থাকেই।

questionText: Complete the sentence: "The thief was caught _____."
explanation: "Red handed" means caught in the act of doing something wrong — হাতেনাতে ধরা পড়া। তাই "The thief was caught red handed" অর্থ চোরটি হাতেনাতে ধরা পড়েছিল।

questionText: What is the meaning of the idiom "Rainy day"?
explanation: "Rainy day" একটি জনপ্রিয় বাগধারা যার অর্থ কষ্টের সময় বা দুঃসময়।

questionText: Complete the sentence: "_____ is a memorable day for students."
explanation: "Rag day" বলতে সাধারণত শিক্ষাজীবনের শেষ স্মরনীয় দিনকে বোঝায়, যা শিক্ষার্থীদের জন্য অত্যন্ত আনন্দময় ও আনন্দের দিন।

questionText: What is the meaning of "Red tape"?
explanation: "Red tape" বাগধারাটির অর্থ দাপ্তরিক নিয়মকানুনের জট বা আমলাতান্ত্রিকতা (bureaucracy)।

questionText: Complete the sentence: "Politicians _____ with innocent people."
explanation: "Play false" means to deceive or act dishonestly — প্রতারণা করা বা বিশ্বাসঘাতকতা করা। তাই বাক্যটির অর্থ দাঁড়ায় politicians সাধারণ মানুষের সাথে প্রতারণা করে।

questionText: What is the meaning of "Play fair"?
explanation: "Play fair" অর্থ ন্যায্য বা সৎ আচরণ করা, অর্থাৎ ভালো আচরণ করা।

questionText: Complete the sentence: "He _____ the lamp."
explanation: "Put out" phrasal verb-টির অর্থ কোনো কিছু নেভানো (extinguish)। তাই "He put out the lamp" মানে সে বাতিটি নিভিয়ে দিয়েছিল।

questionText: Complete the sentence: "He _____ his bag."
explanation: "Put off" এখানে কোনো বস্তু খুলে রাখা বা সরিয়ে রাখার অর্থে ব্যবহৃত হয়েছে।

questionText: What is the meaning of "Point blank"?
explanation: "Point blank" phrase-টির অর্থ খুব স্পষ্টভাবে বা সরাসরি (directly / plainly)।

questionText: Complete the sentence: "This book is now _____."
explanation: "Out of stock" মানে বিক্রয়কেন্দ্রে বা মজুতে আর কোনো বই অবশিষ্ট না থাকা (নভ্য/মজুত শেষ)।

questionText: Complete the sentence: "He is _____ a good man."
explanation: "Out and out" একটি idiom যার অর্থ পুরোদস্তুর বা হাড়কাটা/সম্পূর্ণভাবে (thoroughly)। সুতরাং "He is out and out a good man" অর্থ সে একজন পুরোদস্তুর ভালো মানুষ।

questionText: What is the meaning of "Open mind"?
explanation: "Open mind" বলতে বোঝায় উদার বা খোলা মন।

questionText: Complete the sentence: "He tried _____ to achieve his goal."
explanation: "Once and again" বাগধারাটির অর্থ একাধিকবার বা বারবার (repeatedly)।

questionText: What is the Bengali meaning of "On and on"?
explanation: "On and on" phrase-টির বাংলা অর্থ হলো থামা ছাড়া বা ক্রমাগত (continuously)।

questionText: Complete the sentence: "The thief entered the room _____."
explanation: "On tip toe" means quietly or stealthily — পা টিপে টিপে নিঃশব্দে হাঁটা। তাই চোরটি কক্ষে পা টিপে টিপে ঢুকেছিল।

questionText: Complete the sentence: "He left the village _____."
explanation: "Once for all" means permanently or finally — চিরতরে বা শেষবারের মতো। তাই সে গ্রাম ছেড়ে চিরতরে চলে গেল।

questionText: What is the meaning of the idiom "Of late"?
explanation: "Of late" হলো একটি idiom যার বাংলা অর্থ সম্প্রতি বা ইদানীং (recently)।

questionText: What is the meaning of the phrase "Of course"?
explanation: "Of course" বাক্যাংশটির বাংলা অর্থ অবশ্যই (certainly)।

questionText: Complete the sentence: "It is _____ to me whether you help me or not."
explanation: "No matter" মানে কোনো ব্যাপার নয়। বাক্যটিতে বলা হয়েছে, তুমি সাহায্য করো বা না করো তাতে আমার কিছু যায় আসে না।

questionText: What is the meaning of the idiom "Now and then"?
explanation: "Now and then" idiom-টির বাংলা অর্থ হলো মাঝে মাঝে বা সময়ে সময়ে (occasionally)।

questionText: Complete the sentence: "Sher-e-Bangla was a _____."
explanation: "Man of word" বাক্যাংশটির অর্থ হলো এককথার মানুষ বা কথা রাখার লোক। শের-ই-বাংলা একেই নির্দেশ করে।

questionText: Complete the sentence: "I could not _____ the meaning of the poem."
explanation: "Make out" অর্থ বুঝতে পারা (understand)। তাই কবিতাটির অর্থ বুঝতে না পারা বোঝাতে "make out" ব্যবহৃত হয়েছে।

questionText: What is the meaning of the phrase "Make sure"?
explanation: "Make sure" ইংরেজি বাক্যাংশটির সঠিক বাংলা অর্থ হলো "নিশ্চিত করা"।

questionText: Complete the sentence: "He made _____ for me in the bench."
explanation: "Make room" একটি বাগধারা যার অর্থ স্থান বা জায়গা করে দেওয়া। তাই সঠিক উত্তর হলো "room"।

questionText: What is the meaning of the phrase "Make good"?
explanation: "Make good" বাক্যাংশটির অর্থ হলো কোনো ক্ষতি বা পাওনা পরিশোধ/ক্ষতিপূরণ করা (compensate)।

questionText: Complete the sentence: "We should _____ something against rainy day."
explanation: "Lay by" অর্থ ভবিষ্যতের বা দুর্দিনের জন্য সঞ্চয় করা। তাই দুর্দিনের উদ্দেশ্যে কিছু জমা রাখা বোঝাতে "lay by" ব্যবহৃত হয়।

questionText: What is the meaning of the phrase "Long since"?
explanation: "Long since" বাক্যাংশের অর্থ হলো অনেক কাল আগে বা "অনেক দিন পূর্বে"।

questionText: What is the meaning of the phrase "Long for"?
explanation: "Long for" মানে কোনো কিছুর তীব্র আকাঙ্ক্ষা করা বা "ইচ্ছা করা" (desire strongly)।

questionText: Complete the sentence: "I am _____ a good job."
explanation: "Look for" অর্থ কোনো কিছু খোঁজা। চাকরি খোঁজা বোঝাতে "looking for" উপযুক্ত।

questionText: Complete the sentence: "We should _____ our parents."
explanation: "Look after" অর্থ দেখাশোনা বা যত্ন নেওয়া (take care of)। পিতামাতার দেখাশোনা করা বোঝাতে "look after" সঠিক।

questionText: What is the meaning of the phrase "Bad blood"?
explanation: "Bad blood" ইডিঅমের অর্থ শত্রুতা বা "মনোমালিন্য" (ill feeling/enmity)।

questionText: Complete the sentence: "We should save money against a _____."
explanation: "Rainy day" অর্থ দুর্দিন বা সংকটের সময়। ভবিষ্যতের দুর্দিনের জন্য অর্থ জমানো বোঝাতে "rainy day" ব্যবহৃত হয়।

questionText: What is the meaning of the phrase "A black sheep"?
explanation: "A black sheep" বাক্যাংশের অর্থ হলো সমাজের বা পরিবারের "কুলাঙ্গার" ব্যক্তিসত্ত্বা।

questionText: Which idiom best completes the sentence: "The president and the secretary of the club are _____."
explanation: "At daggers drawn" অর্থ ঘোর শত্রুভাবাপন্ন বা প্রচণ্ড বিরোধে থাকা।

questionText: Which phrase means "কিংকর্তব্যবিমূঢ়"?
explanation: "At a loss" ইডিঅমটির অর্থ হলো হতবুদ্ধি বা "কিংকর্তব্যবিমূঢ়" (perplexed)।

questionText: Complete the sentence with the appropriate idiom: "Life is not a _____."
explanation: "Bed of roses" অর্থ পুষ্পশয্যা বা আরামদায়ক জীবন। "Life is not a bed of roses" একটি বহুল প্রচলিত প্রবাদ।

questionText: What is the Bangla meaning of the idiom "According to"?
explanation: "According to" ইডিঅমটির বাংলা অনুবাদ হলো "অনুসারে"।

questionText: Which sentence follows the pattern "Sub (NP) + Tr.v + obj(NP) + obj (Pronoun)"?
explanation: "I saw the king himself" বাক্যে 'I' হলো Subject (NP), 'saw' হলো Transitive verb, 'the king' হলো Object (NP), এবং 'himself' হলো Object Pronoun।

questionText: What is the structural pattern of the sentence "They torn the letter open"?
explanation: এই বাক্যে 'They' হলো Sub (NP), 'torn' হলো Transitive verb (Tr.v), 'the letter' হলো Object (NP), এবং 'open' হলো Object Complement Adjective (Obj(Adj))।

questionText: Which sentence follows the pattern "Sub (NP) + Transitive verb + Obj (NP)"?
options: She went to the MD herself.
Life is not a bed of roses.
explanation: "He eats rice" বাক্যে 'He' হলো Subject Noun Phrase (NP), 'eats' হলো Transitive verb এবং 'rice' হলো Object Noun Phrase (NP)।

questionText: This game is open _____ all.
explanation: The phrase 'open to all' means accessible or available to everyone — সবার জন্য উন্মুক্ত। Therefore, 'to' is the correct appropriate preposition.

questionText: This line occurs _____ the poem "The Cloud".
explanation: When referring to lines or sentences found inside a poem, story, or book, we use the preposition 'in' — কোনো কবিতা বা বইয়ের মধ্যে লাইন থাকা বোঝাতে 'in' ব্যবহৃত হয়।

questionText: The idea never occurred _____ me.
explanation: The appropriate preposition after 'occur' when meaning an idea comes to someone's mind is 'to' (occur to someone — কারও মনে হওয়া বা রেখাপাত করা)।

questionText: I am obliged to him _____ his kind help.
explanation: We say 'obliged to (someone) for (something)' — কোনো সাহায্যের জন্য কারও কাছে কৃতজ্ঞ থাকা বোঝাতে 'for' ব্যবহৃত হয়।

questionText: Why did you object _____ his proposal?
explanation: The verb 'object' takes the appropriate preposition 'to' when indicating disapproval or opposition to something (object to something — কোনো কিছুতে আপত্তি জানানো)।

questionText: I am in need _____ more money.
explanation: The phrase 'in need of' is an appropriate idiomatic expression meaning needing or requiring something — কোনো কিছুর প্রয়োজন হওয়া।

questionText: I have no need _____ more money.
explanation: When 'need' is used as a noun followed by what is needed in a general sense, 'need for' is standardly used (e.g., 'no need for more money').

questionText: Kasheem is married _____ a fat woman.
explanation: The verb 'married' takes the preposition 'to' when specifying the spouse (married to someone — কারও সাথে বিবাহিত)। 'With' is incorrect here.

questionText: The cloth is made _____ cotton.
explanation: We use 'made of' when the material does not fundamentally change its identity during the manufacturing process (e.g., cloth made of cotton).

questionText: He is mad _____ pain.
explanation: The phrase 'mad with' means overwhelmed or driven out of mind by an emotion or physical sensation (mad with pain — যন্ত্রণায় অস্থির বা খেপাটে হওয়া)।

questionText: Everybody should be loyal _____ his duty.
explanation: The adjective 'loyal' takes the appropriate preposition 'to' (loyal to someone/something — অনুগত বা নিষ্ঠাবান)।

questionText: Look _____ the word in the dictionary.
explanation: The phrasal verb 'look up' means to search for information in a reference book such as a dictionary — অভিধানে কোনো শব্দ খোঁজা।

questionText: He is looking _____ the answer paper.
explanation: The phrasal verb 'look over' means to examine or inspect quickly (look over an answer paper — উত্তরপত্র ঘুরেফিরে দেখা বা পরীক্ষা করা)।

questionText: I am looking _____ the matter.
explanation: The phrasal verb 'look into' means to investigate or examine deeply — কোনো বিষয় তদন্ত করা।

questionText: What are you looking _____?
explanation: The phrasal verb 'look for' means to search for something or someone — কোনো কিছু খোঁজা।

questionText: Mother looks _____ her children.
explanation: The phrasal verb 'look after' means to take care of someone — দেখাশোনা করা বা যত্ন নেওয়া।

questionText: Look _____ the picture.
explanation: The phrasal verb 'look at' means to direct one's eyes towards something — কোনো কিছুর দিকে তাকানো।

questionText: He lives _____ fame.
explanation: The phrase 'live for' means to have something as the main goal or purpose in life (live for fame — খ্যাতির উদ্দেশ্যে বেঁচে থাকা)।

questionText: He lives _____ honest means.
explanation: The phrase 'live by' means to support oneself using a particular method or source of income (live by honest means — সৎ উপায়ে জীবিকা নির্বাহ করা)।

questionText: The cow lives _____ grass.
explanation: The phrase 'live on' means to consume a particular food as the primary diet (live on grass — ঘাস খেয়ে বেঁচে থাকা)।

questionText: You should have a limit _____ your demands.
explanation: The noun 'limit' is followed by the preposition 'to' when indicating a restriction or bound placed on something.

questionText: We should not laugh _____ the poor.
explanation: The phrase 'laugh at' means to mock or make fun of someone, making 'at' the correct preposition.

questionText: Don't be late _____ going there.
explanation: 'Late in' is used when referring to a delay in doing a specific action or task.

questionText: It is a great regret that he is lame _____ two legs.
explanation: 'Lame of' is the appropriate prepositional phrase used when describing physical lameness in one or both legs.

questionText: What kind _____ noun is it?
explanation: 'Kind of' is a standard English phrase used to denote a specific category or type of something.

questionText: Hard work is the key _____ success.
explanation: The noun 'key' takes the preposition 'to' when it refers to the essential means of attaining a goal.

questionText: Jabir is junior _____ me in service.
explanation: Adjectives derived from Latin ending in '-ior' (such as junior, senior, superior) are followed by 'to' instead of 'than'.

questionText: We should not jump _____ a conclusion without thinking.
explanation: 'Jump to a conclusion' is an idiomatic phrase meaning to form an opinion hastily without examining all facts.

questionText: He hit _____ a plan.
explanation: 'Hit upon' is a phrasal verb that means to discover or think of an idea unexpectedly.

questionText: I cannot guess _____ her age.
explanation: 'Guess at' means to try to estimate or form an opinion about something without precise knowledge.

questionText: I am grateful _____ you for helping me.
explanation: We use 'grateful to' when referring to the person receiving thanks and 'grateful for' for the thing received.

questionText: Zainul was good _____ Mathematics.
explanation: 'Good at' is used to express skill, competence, or proficiency in a subject or activity.

questionText: Forest is full _____ animal.
explanation: The adjective 'full' correctly pairs with the preposition 'of' to indicate containing or holding many things.

questionText: The trunk is filled _____ water.
explanation: The verb 'filled' is followed by 'with' to describe an object being made full of a liquid or substance.

questionText: Badsha is not fit _____ the job.
explanation: 'Fit for' indicates suitability or qualification for a specific role or purpose.

questionText: The cow feeds _____ grass.
explanation: 'Feed on' means to consume a particular type of food as part of a regular diet.

questionText: Rajshahi is famous _____ mango.
explanation: 'Famous for' is used to indicate the particular reason or feature for which a place or person is well known.

questionText: Cat is faithful _____ his master.
explanation: 'Faithful to' expresses devotion, loyalty, or allegiance to someone or something.

questionText: I have faith _____ you.
explanation: 'Faith in' refers to having complete trust, belief, or confidence in someone or something.

questionText: Runa Laila excels _____ music.
explanation: The verb 'excel' is followed by 'in' to indicate showing exceptional skill or talent in a specific area.

questionText: The students entered _____ the class.
explanation:
When 'enter' means going inside a place, 'into' is often used in basic English assessments to indicate motion toward the inside.
তাই, 'entered into the class' দ্বারা শ্রেণীকক্ষে প্রবেশ করা বোঝায়।

questionText: He is eligible _____ the post.
explanation:
Appropriate preposition 'eligible for' means suitable or qualified for something (কোনো পদের জন্য যোগ্য)।
তাই 'He is eligible for the post' বাক্যটি সঠিক।

questionText: Rabi is absent due _____ his illness.
explanation:
The appropriate phrase 'due to' means because of (কারণে)।
তাই অসুস্থতার কারণে অনুপস্থিত থাকা বোঝাতে 'due to his illness' সঠিক।

questionText: He died _____ his country.
explanation:
'Die for' is used when someone sacrifices their life for a cause or country (দেশের জন্য জীবন দেওয়া)।
তাই 'died for his country' ব্যবহৃত হয়েছে।

questionText: He died _____ cholera.
explanation:
'Die of' is used when dying from a specific disease like cholera (রোগে মারা যাওয়া)।
তাই 'died of cholera' সঠিক।

questionText: Rafique deals _____ rice.
explanation:
'Deal in' means to trade or conduct business in a commodity (ব্যবসা করা)।
তাই চালের ব্যবসা করা বোঝাতে 'deals in rice' সঠিক।

questionText: He is deaf _____ my request.
explanation:
'Deaf to' means refusing to listen or pay attention to a request/advice (কান না দেওয়া বা উপেক্ষা করা)।
তাই 'deaf to my request' সঠিক।

questionText: I cannot cope _____ the situation.
explanation:
The correct idiom is 'cope with', which means to manage or handle a situation (মানিয়ে নেওয়া বা সামলানো)।
গ্রামারে 'cope up with' ভুল প্রয়োগ, 'cope with' সঠিক।

questionText: He will be cured _____ the disease very soon.
explanation:
Appropriate preposition 'cured of' means restored to health from an illness (রোগমুক্ত হওয়া)।
তাই 'cured of the disease' সঠিক।

questionText: Mr. Shafiq has no control _____ his son.
explanation:
'Control over' is used to denote power, authority, or influence over someone or something (নিয়ন্ত্রণ থাকা)।
তাই 'control over his son' সঠিক।

questionText: I shall comply _____ your request.
explanation:
'Comply with' means to act in accordance with a request, rule, or wish (সম্মতি জানানো বা মেনে চলা)।
তাই 'comply with your request' সঠিক।

questionText: Nazrul may be compared _____ Byron.
explanation:
When comparing two persons or things of the same kind, 'compare with' is used (সমজাতীয় ব্যক্তি বা বস্তুর মধ্যে তুলনা করা)।
তাই নজরুল ও বায়রনের তুলনার ক্ষেত্রে 'compared with' সঠিক।

questionText: The School is very close _____ my house.
explanation:
Appropriate preposition 'close to' means near in distance or position (নিকটে বা কাছে)।
তাই 'close to my house' সঠিক।

questionText: Sumon was charged _____ theft.
explanation:
Appropriate preposition 'charged with' means officially accused of a crime or offense (অভিযুক্ত হওয়া)।
তাই চুরি করার অভিযোগে অভিযুক্ত বোঝাতে 'charged with theft' সঠিক।

questionText: Take care _____ your health.
explanation:
The idiom 'take care of' means to look after or attend to one's health/well-being (যত্ন নেওয়া)।
তাই 'take care of your health' সঠিক।

questionText: He is busy _____ his business.
explanation:
Appropriate preposition 'busy with' means actively engaged in a task or work (কোনো কাজে ব্যস্ত থাকা)।
তাই 'busy with his business' সঠিক।

questionText: The girl burst _____ laughing at the joke.
explanation:
'Burst out' is followed by a gerund (verb+ing) to mean suddenly starting to do something like laughing (হেসে ওঠা)।
তাই 'burst out laughing' সঠিক।

questionText: Saiful burst _____ tears at the sad news.
explanation:
'Burst into' is followed by a noun to mean suddenly breaking into a state like tears (কান্নায় ভেঙে পড়া)।
তাই 'burst into tears' সঠিক।

questionText: He is aware _____ the fact.
explanation:
Appropriate preposition 'aware of' means having knowledge or consciousness of something (সচেতন বা অবগত থাকা)।
তাই 'aware of the fact' সঠিক।

questionText: Every student should attend _____ his study.
explanation:
'Attend to' means to pay attention or devote mind to something (মনোযোগ দেওয়া)।
তাই পড়াশোনায় মনোযোগ দেওয়া বোঝাতে 'attend to his study' সঠিক।

questionText: He talks as if he _____ (be) mad.
explanation: 'As if' বা 'as though' দিয়ে অবাস্তব তুলনা বোঝালে subject যাই হোক না কেন be-verb হিসেবে 'were' বসে।

questionText: I am fond of _____ (read) novels.
explanation: Preposition (of)-এর পর verb আসলে তার সাথে -ing যুক্ত হয়ে gerund গঠন করে, তাই 'reading' সঠিক।

questionText: I wish I _____ (be) a poet.
explanation: 'I wish' দিয়ে অবাস্তব কল্পনা বা ইচ্ছা প্রকাশ পেলে be-verb হিসেবে 'were' বসে।

questionText: It _____ (rain) today.
explanation: 'Today' বর্তমান সময় নির্দেশ করায় বাক্যটিতে Present Continuous Tense (is raining) ব্যবহৃত হয়েছে।

questionText: He _____ (come) here last night.
explanation: 'Last night' দ্বারা অতীত সময় নির্দেশ করায় বাক্যটি Simple Past Tense-এ হবে, তাই verb-এর past form 'came' বসেছে।

questionText: He is _____ (go) to school.
explanation: Auxiliary verb 'is'-এর পর মূল verb-এর সাথে -ing যুক্ত হয়ে Present Continuous Tense (is going) গঠিত হয়।

questionText: It _____ (rain) since Monday last.
explanation: 'Since' দিয়ে অতীতে কাজ শুরু হয়ে এখনও চলছে বোঝালে Present Perfect Continuous Tense (has been raining) হয়।

questionText: I wish I _____ (be) a textile engineer.
explanation: 'I wish' দ্বারা অবাস্তব আকাঙ্ক্ষা প্রকাশ পাওয়ায় be-verb হিসেবে 'were' বসেছে।

questionText: I am fond of _____ (read) English magazine.
explanation: Preposition 'of'-এর পর verb আসলে তার সাথে -ing যোগ হয়ে Gerund (reading) গঠিত হয়।

questionText: He is _____ (go) to institute.
explanation: Present Continuous Tense-এর গঠন অনুযায়ী 'is'-এর পর verb-এর সঙ্গে -ing যুক্ত होकर 'going' হবে।

questionText: You had better _____ (to see) a doctor.
explanation: 'Had better' হলো একটি modal auxiliary structure, যার পর সবসময় verb-এর base form (bare infinitive) বসে।

questionText: It _____ (rain) for seven days.
explanation: 'For seven days' দিয়ে সময় নির্দেশ করায় কোনো কাজ অতীতে শুরু হয়ে এখনও চলছে বোঝাতে Present Perfect Continuous Tense ব্যবহৃত হয়।

questionText: You should _____ (speak) the truth.
explanation: Modal auxiliary verb 'should'-এর পর সবসময় verb-এর base form (speak) বসে।

questionText: The girl came to me _____ (dance).
explanation: একই বাক্যে দুটি মূল ক্রিয়া থাকলে এবং দ্বিতীয়টি কোন অবস্থা প্রকাশ করলে তার সাথে -ing যুক্ত হয়ে Present Participle (dancing) গঠন করে।

questionText: We _____ (expect) him here yesterday.
explanation: 'Yesterday' দ্বারা অতীত সময় নির্দেশ করায় verb-এর Past Simple form 'expected' ব্যবহৃত হয়েছে।

questionText: Having _____ (finish) the work, he reached home at night.
explanation: Perfect Participle-এর নিয়মানুযায়ী 'Having'-এর পর verb-এর Past Participle (V3) form অর্থাৎ 'finished' বসে।

questionText: The earth _____ (move) round the sun.
explanation: চিরন্তন সত্য (Universal Truth) প্রকাশে Present Indefinite Tense হয় এবং 'The earth' Singular হওয়ায় verb-এর শেষে 's' যুক্ত হয়ে 'moves' হবে।

questionText: Is this your ___ cat?
explanation: Possessive pronoun 'your'-এর পর জোর প্রদান করতে 'own' ব্যবহৃত হয়ে অর্থপূর্ণ বাক্য গঠন করে।

questionText: This is ___ pen.
explanation: Noun 'pen'-এর আগে মালিকানা প্রকাশ করতে possessive adjective 'my' সবচেয়ে উপযুক্ত।

questionText: ___ man is your uncle?
explanation: কাউকে বা কোনো নির্দিষ্ট ব্যক্তিকে চিহ্নিত করার জন্য প্রশ্নসূচক বাক্য তৈরিতে 'Which' ব্যবহৃত হয়।

questionText: Fill in the blank with the appropriate word: '___ honest man is true to his words.'
explanation: The word 'honest' begins with a silent 'h' and a vowel sound /ɒ/, so the indefinite article 'An' is used before it.

questionText: What part of speech is the word 'appointment' in the sentence: 'He made an urgent appointment to see him...'?
explanation: The word 'appointment' names a scheduled arrangement and is preceded by the article 'an' and adjective 'urgent', making it a Noun.

questionText: What part of speech is the word 'busy' in the sentence: 'The doctor was a busy man.'?
explanation: The word 'busy' modifies the noun 'man' by describing his state or condition, so it functions as an Adjective.

questionText: What part of speech is the word 'honourable' in the sentence: '...consult an honourable doctor.'?
explanation: The word 'honourable' qualifies the noun 'doctor', describing his status or quality, so it is an Adjective.

questionText: What part of speech is the word 'decided' in the sentence: 'He decided to consult an honourable doctor.'?
explanation: The word 'decided' expresses the main action performed by the subject 'He', making it a Verb.

questionText: What part of speech is the word 'from' in the sentence: '...suffering from a lot of troubles.'?
explanation: The word 'from' connects the verb 'suffering' to its object 'a lot of troubles', functioning as a Preposition.

questionText: What part of speech is the word 'So' in the sentence: 'So he had been suffering from a lot of troubles.'?
explanation: The word 'So' links the sentence to the preceding context to show a cause-and-effect relationship, acting as a Conjunction.

questionText: What part of speech is the word 'healthy' in the sentence: 'But he was not a healthy boy.'?
explanation: The word 'healthy' modifies the noun 'boy' by describing his physical state, so it is an Adjective.

questionText: What part of speech is the word 'hard' in the sentence: '...began to work hard.'?
explanation: The word 'hard' modifies the verb 'work', telling us how the action was performed, making it an Adverb.

questionText: What part of speech is the word 'well' in the sentence: 'Kamal determined to do well in the examination'?
explanation: The word 'well' modifies the verb 'do', describing the manner of performance, so it is an Adverb.

questionText: What type of sentence is: "Alas! I have failed."
explanation: Sentences expressing strong sudden emotion or sorrow, usually accompanied by an exclamation mark, are Exclamatory sentences.

questionText: What type of sentence is: "Hurrah! we have won the game."
explanation: This sentence expresses sudden joy using the interjection 'Hurrah!' and an exclamation mark, making it an Exclamatory sentence.

questionText: What type of sentence is: "Get out of my room."
explanation: A sentence that expresses a direct command, order, or request is an Imperative sentence.

questionText: What type of sentence is: "How long did you wait for me?"
explanation: A sentence that asks a question and ends with a question mark is an Interrogative sentence.

questionText: What type of sentence is: "May Allah bless you."
explanation: Sentences expressing a prayer, wish, or desire (typically beginning with 'May') are Optative sentences.

questionText: What type of sentence is: "Let us play in the field."
explanation: Sentences beginning with 'Let' that express a proposal, suggestion, or command are Imperative sentences.

questionText: What type of sentence is: "The girl is very beautiful."
explanation: A sentence that states a fact or makes a general declaration is an Assertive sentence.

questionText: What type of sentence is: "Let Karim go home."
explanation: A sentence starting with 'Let' to give permission or an order is classified as an Imperative sentence.

questionText: Transform into an Exclamatory sentence: "The horse is a very strong animal."
options: What a strong animal the horse is!
How strong animal the horse is!
What strong animal the horse is!
How a strong animal the horse is!
answer: What a strong animal the horse is!
explanation: When transforming an assertive sentence containing 'a very + adjective + singular noun', the exclamatory structure follows 'What + a/an + adjective + noun + subject + verb!'.

questionText: Transform into Passive voice: "It pulls cart."
options: Cart is being pulled by it.
Cart has been pulled by it.
explanation: In simple present tense, the passive transformation follows: Object + am/is/are + past participle of verb + by + Subject. Thus, 'It pulls cart' becomes 'Cart is pulled by it.'

questionText: In the sentence "Who has broken the glass?", what kind of pronoun is "Who"?
explanation: The word "Who" is used to ask a direct question in this sentence, making it an Interrogative Pronoun (প্রশ্নবোধক সর্বনাম).

questionText: In the sentence "I myself did the work", what kind of pronoun is "myself"?
explanation: When a self-pronoun immediately follows the subject pronoun to emphasize who performed the action, it functions as an Emphatic Pronoun.

questionText: In the sentence "He killed himself", what kind of pronoun is "himself"?
explanation: When the subject and object of a sentence refer to the same person, the pronoun is a Reflexive Pronoun (আত্মঘটিত সর্বনাম).

questionText: Fill in the blank with a suitable pronoun: This book is ___.
explanation: "Mine" is a possessive pronoun used independently without a following noun to indicate ownership (বইটি আমার).

questionText: Fill in the blank with a suitable pronoun: Dhaka is ___ capital city.
explanation: "Our" is a possessive adjective placed before the noun phrase "capital city" to show relation.

questionText: Fill in the blank with a suitable pronoun: I love ___ very much.
explanation: "Him" is an objective personal pronoun used as the direct object of the verb "love".

questionText: Fill in the blank with a suitable pronoun: ___ is a beautiful bird.
explanation: "It" is a personal pronoun used as the subject to refer to an animal or object (যেমন: bird).

questionText: Fill in the blank with a suitable pronoun: The two girls are ___ cousins.
explanation: "Our" is a possessive word used before the noun "cousins" to modify it.

questionText: Fill in the blank with a suitable pronoun: She killed ___.
explanation: "Herself" is the reflexive pronoun that correctly corresponds to the feminine subject pronoun "She".

questionText: Fill in the blank with a suitable pronoun: ___ did you see?
explanation: "Whom" is the objective case interrogative pronoun used when asking about the object of the action (তুমি কাকে দেখেছিলে?).

questionText: Fill in the blank with a suitable pronoun: They hurt ___.
explanation: "Themselves" is the plural reflexive pronoun corresponding to the subject "They".

questionText: Fill in the blank with a suitable pronoun: This pen is better than ___.
explanation: "Mine" is used here as a possessive pronoun meaning "my pen" to compare two possessions.

questionText: Fill in the blank with a suitable pronoun: I ___ saw the man.
explanation: "Myself" is the emphatic pronoun that directly corresponds to and emphasizes the subject "I".

questionText: In the sentence, "He made an urgent appointment to see him one afternoon", what part of speech is "appointment"?
explanation: "Appointment" is a Noun (বিশেষ্য) preceded by the article "an" and the adjective "urgent".

questionText: In the sentence, "The doctor was a busy man", what part of speech is "busy"?
explanation: "Busy" is an Adjective (বিশেষণ) because it describes the condition or quality of the noun "man".

questionText: In the sentence, "He decided to consult an honourable doctor", what part of speech is "honourable"?
explanation: "Honourable" is an Adjective modifying the noun "doctor" by describing his quality.

questionText: In the sentence, "He decided to consult an honourable doctor", what part of speech is "decided"?
explanation: "Decided" is a Verb (ক্রিয়া) expressing the past action performed by the subject "He".

questionText: In the sentence, "So he had been suffering from a lot of troubles", what part of speech is "from"?
explanation: "From" is a Preposition (পদান্বয়ী অব্যয়) used after "suffering" to indicate cause.

questionText: In the sentence, "So he had been suffering from a lot of troubles", what part of speech is "So"?
explanation: "So" functions as a Conjunction (সংযোজক অব্যয়) here, linking the sentence logically to a previous context.

questionText: In the sentence, "But he was not a healthy boy", what part of speech is "healthy"?
explanation: "Healthy" is an Adjective (বিশেষণ) modifying the noun "boy".
